rules.name: Printer Reboot
rules.description: Known printer MAC disappeared — likely a routine reboot.

rules.name: DHCP Renewal
rules.description: Asset IP changed — consistent with DHCP renewal on IT VLAN.

rules.name: Unknown Asset on OT VLAN
rules.description: New unrecognised device appeared on an OT-designated subnet.

rules.name: MAC Address Changed
rules.description: MAC address changed for a known IP — possible ARP spoofing or NIC swap.

rules.name: Modbus Write from Unknown Source
rules.description: Modbus write command (FC 5/6/15/16) detected from a non-whitelisted source.

rules.name: PROFINET DCP Set Command
rules.description: PROFINET DCP Set command detected from unknown MAC — possible PLC reconfiguration attempt.

rules.name: Unauthorized EtherNet/IP Session
rules.description: EtherNet/IP RegisterSession from non-whitelisted source — possible unauthorized CIP access.
